status: UTC timestamp unit constructor and accessor component; duration arithmetic, Local timezones, production integration and whole-product qualification remain separate gates.

compiler.bootstrap: Explicit Python B0, followed by native HIA B1, B2, B3 and component compilation.

entry.signature: u64 f0(const u8* source, u64 source_len, u8* output, u64 output_capacity, u8* workspace, u64 workspace_len)
entry.status_encoding: Core u32 zero extended to u64 by the fixed native borrowed-buffer wrapper.

caller_preconditions: Advertised source and output ranges are live for the synchronous call, readable for source and writable for output.
Source and output ranges do not overlap, including exact aliasing. Source is not concurrently modified.
No alignment is required. Lengths are actual allocated capacities; invalid pointers or invented capacities are outside the contract.
Zero-length workspace is never read or written. Native retains no pointers and has no mutable global state.

source.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed argument uses two's-complement bits

fields.name: operation
fields.meaning: 0: seconds plus nanoseconds; 1: seconds; 2: milliseconds; 3: microseconds; 4: nanoseconds

fields.name: argument
fields.meaning: signed i64 timestamp in the unit selected by operation

fields.name: nanoseconds
fields.meaning: u64 nanoseconds for operation 0; required zero for operations 1 through 4

source.mutation: Never modified; all eight words are loaded before any output write.

output.byte_order: ten little-endian u64 words; signed values use two's-complement bits

fields.name: valid
fields.value: 1 when the original constructor succeeds; otherwise 0

fields.name: unix_nanoseconds
fields.value: signed timestamp_nanos_opt() value when present; otherwise 0

output.tail: Bytes after offset 80 remain unchanged. Frame and capacity errors leave the entire output unchanged.

semantics.fraction: For operation 0, nanoseconds must be below 2000000000; values at least 1000000000 require the Euclidean second within the minute to be 59. Values outside u32 are rejected by the observer's explicit argument-type guard, matching the wider ABI extension.
semantics.unit_construction: Use Euclidean quotient and remainder for seconds, milliseconds, microseconds and nanoseconds, including negative i64 values. Compute the remainder directly and adjust it; never reconstruct a possibly overflowing floor quotient times divisor.
semantics.accessors: Millis and micros use non-leap seconds multiplied by 1000/1000000 plus truncated subsecond units. Leap fractions can make the subsecond accessors exceed ordinary 999/999999 limits. The full Chrono timestamp range fits both accessors in i64.
semantics.nanosecond_option: Preserve the original checked operation order: for negative seconds add one to seconds and subtract one billion from the fraction; checked multiply adjusted seconds by one billion, then checked add the adjusted fraction. A failed check produces nanos_valid=0 and unix_nanoseconds=0 while retaining the valid DateTime and other units.
semantics.scope: UTC constructors and timestamp accessors only. DateTime/TimeDelta addition, subtraction, ordering adapters, Local timezone conversion and production API integration are separate.

status_precedence.condition: output capacity is below 80, before reading source or validating workspace
source size is not 64, workspace is nonempty, version is not 1, operation is outside 0..4, any reserved word is nonzero, or nanoseconds is nonzero for operations 1..4
valid frame; exactly 80 output bytes encode the original constructed DateTime and accessors, or version 1 followed by zero words when construction fails

differential_corpus.coverage: All original calendar constructor cases, nanosecond-option lower/upper boundaries with leap and ordinary fractions, every i64 power-of-two neighborhood, i64 minimum/maximum neighborhoods, full Chrono unit boundaries and deterministic generated i64 inputs.
differential_corpus.controls: Two fills and exact/excess output capacities for every semantic case. All 80 shorter output capacities for each operation; truncated and oversized source, invalid metadata, nonempty workspace, and nonzero unused nanoseconds. All inputs, outputs, tails and unaligned guards compared.
differential_corpus.recording: Complete input, original output and native-call transcript retained as gzip streams, with SHA-256 hashes of every uncompressed byte.
